name: thoughtfull
description: ThoughtFull session booking with persistent in-app reminders

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run worker --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend && npm run test:e2e --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
